Constructions and their induced maps

A reusable mathematical construction retains an object, its action on maps, and the data needed for the next construction.
Our route: directed dependency → dependent Hom → whole homology → a nonzero connecting map.
The current main book supplies the mathematics. The RHPL overview supplies the computational perspective.

Directed families and transport

E:K⟶U,U=CatcartE:K\longrightarrow U,\qquad U=\mathsf{Cat}_{\mathrm{cart}}E:K⟶U,U=Catcart​
A fibre E[x] is a category. An arrow f:x→y supplies transport E[f]:E[x]→E[y], together with the declared higher action.
(x,u)→(f,a)(y,v),a:E[f](u)⟶v(x,u)\xrightarrow{(f,a)}(y,v),\qquad a:E[f](u)\longrightarrow v(x,u)(f,a)​(y,v),a:E[f](u)⟶v
Current convention: strict functors, with the specified lax transformations. The Cartesian coefficient does not make every base comparison invertible.

Emdash · computational mathematicsThe dependent-Hom ladder

The dependent Hom

homd⁡E(x,u)[y][v][f]=Hom⁡E[y](E[f](u),v)\operatorname{homd}_E(x,u)[y][v][f]=\operatorname{Hom}_{E[y]}(E[f](u),v)homdE​(x,u)[y][v][f]=HomE[y]​(E[f](u),v)
Five parameters: x and y in K; u in E[x]; v in E[y]; and f:x→y. The family E remains fixed in this discussion.
First transport u along f. Then compare that transported object with v inside E[y]. An object of this Hom is a possible fibre component a.
The central issue is coherent variation in all five parameters. The leaf formula alone does not specify the whole higher construction.

The coefficient category

P(I)=T([I,T(U)]),Hom⁡Q(A,B)=Cart⁡(A,P(B))P(I)=T([I,T(U)]),\qquad\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal Q}(A,B)=\operatorname{Cart}(A,P(B))P(I)=T([I,T(U)]),HomQ​(A,B)=Cart(A,P(B))
Ix=Hom⁡K(x,−),SE(x)=Transf⁡K,Q(ιE,ιIx)I_x=\operatorname{Hom}_K(x,-),\qquad S_E(x)=\operatorname{Transf}_{K,\mathcal Q}(\iota E,\iota I_x)Ix​=HomK​(x,−),SE​(x)=TransfK,Q​(ιE,ιIx​)
U supplies admitted fibres. P retains a varying presheaf classifier. The coefficient category supplies represented maps, mates and their selected composition.
Unfolding a fixed Hom in the coefficient category preserves that composition. It does not replace the whole y-transformation by an ordinary diagonal family.

Source and target variance

Source variation uses represented mates. Its shifted index is covariant on arrows and reverses the next transformation level, accounting for C₂(K).
Target variation uses represented maps and a lax comparison. The outer fibrewise opposite compensates the source shift; the root is strict across x.
{f1,f2}⟶{∗},qf1=k=qf2\{f_1,f_2\}\longrightarrow\{*\},\qquad qf_1=k=qf_2{f1​,f2​}⟶{∗},qf1​=k=qf2​
The ordinary negative-section picture clarifies polarity. Its direct higher extension is not the current construction; the selected solution retains the whole coefficient-valued transformation.

Native inputs for homology

Cn+1→dn+1Cn→dnCn−1,dndn+1=0C_{n+1}\xrightarrow{d_{n+1}}C_n\xrightarrow{d_n}C_{n-1},\qquad d_n d_{n+1}=0Cn+1​dn+1​​Cn​dn​​Cn−1​,dn​dn+1​=0
The native input keeps the incoming object, outgoing arrow diagram and one whole diagram map. Its morphisms retain compatible maps of these data.
The internal Hom and dependent-Hom structure supports this input category. Whole universal operations can then act on both its objects and its maps.
For homological results, work in the stated ordinary additive setting with chosen whole kernel/cokernel structures. Row exactness and normality enter at the later connecting/exactness stages.

A nonsplit polynomial example

R=Q[x],S=R/(x)R=\mathbb Q[x],\qquad S=R/(x)R=Q[x],S=R/(x)
A∙=B∙=(R→xR),D∙=(S→0S)A_\bullet=B_\bullet=(R\xrightarrow{x}R),\qquad D_\bullet=(S\xrightarrow{0}S)A∙​=B∙​=(Rx​R),D∙​=(S0​S)
0⟶R→xR⟶S⟶00\longrightarrow R\xrightarrow{x}R\longrightarrow S\longrightarrow00⟶Rx​R⟶S⟶0
The inclusion multiplies by x in both degrees; the projection is the quotient map. If s:S→R is R-linear, then x·s(1̄)=0, hence s=0. It cannot split the quotient.

Computation, interpretation and proof

Computed: selected presentations, matrices, coefficient witnesses and equations. These data remain available for later calculations.
Supplied: the whole model, its normality, row semantics and agreements with the selected complete arrows.
Derived: canonical image-to-kernel comparison inverses and exactness certificates for the actual displayed diagram. No new output-exactness assumption is added.
A raw calculation, an interpretation contract and a conditional formal derivation have different roles. The current interface preserves those distinctions.

Scope and further reading

The Homd ladder retains coherent parameter action. Whole universal operations retain that action through homology and the connecting transformation.
The nonsplit example makes the computational distinction visible: a nonzero connecting map, relation-aware quotient maps, and selected data reused by a conditional exactness certificate.
Current scope: the stated ordinary/additive structures and supplied model interpretations. General higher models, unbounded complexes and global metatheory are not established by these examples.
Read: current book §2.7.1 and Chapter 31; Appendix G; the November 6 Homd communication draft. RHPL supplies the computational perspective.
